tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Capacity controlled by measure] 1. ch8:8.7\group ch08-generalized-solutions For every bounded measurable $\Omega \subset \mathbb R^n$, \[ |\Omega |^{1-2/n}\leq \gamma (n)\, \capop \Omega , \] where $\gamma (n)$ is the constant in the Sobolev inequality (7.26) for $p=2$.
Proof

\sketch Apply the Sobolev inequality to each compactly supported function that is at least one on $\Omega $, then take the infimum of its Dirichlet energy.

□
